versions.name: Lithium 0.15.4 for Fabric
versions.changelog:
Lithium 0.15.4 for Minecraft 1.21 and 1.21.1 backports a few bug fixes.

Make sure to take a backup of your world before using the mod and please report any bugs and mod compatibility issues at the [issue tracker](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/lithium-fabric/issues). You can check the [description of each optimization](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/lithium/blob/mc1.21.1-0.15.4/lithium-mixin-config.md) and how to disable it when encountering a problem.

## Fixes
- Fix supporting block movement shortcut not offsetting VoxelShape 
- Fix double inventory related inventory invalidation issues
- Avoid crashing when modded levels with broken registries are created
- Fix comparator updates missing for furnaces and brewing stands

versions.name: 21.1.1+fabric-1.21.1
versions.changelog:
- Updated to Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fixed leashed tamed pets desyncing when being teleported
- Fixed warp scrolls not being consumed
- Fixed possible crash when waystones are placed by third party mods
- Changed default of transportPets config option to be DISABLED

versions.name: 21.1.46+fabric-1.21.1
versions.changelog:
- Added `/waystones cooldown <targets> add <identifier> <seconds>` and `/waystones cooldown <targets> set <identifier> <seconds>` commands
- Fixed bound scrolls showing "invalid" for players who have not activated the target
- Fixed lack of error message when warp requirement block scrolls from teleporting
- Fixed scrolls costing XP when they shouldn't
